## construct

- `URAlgebra() -> URAlgebra` — Select the exact U(R) determinant specialization of the o-graph contraction. [contract](URAlgebra.md)

## convert

- `odata(d::URDiagram) -> String` — Render a unit-weight U(R) diagram as its source-format O-data word. [contract](odata.md)

- `plot_urd_structure_svg(d::URDiagram, path::AbstractString) -> String` — Write the UR diagram's signed endpoints, paired edges and weights as SVG and return the absolute file path. [contract](plot_urd_structure_svg.md)

## invariant

- `standard_matrix_trace(C, matrix::AbstractMatrix) -> Any` — Evaluate the legacy standard-matrix trace expression at the supplied coefficients. [contract](standard_matrix_trace.md)
- `trace1(d::URDiagram) -> Any` — Evaluate the unregularized single-edge U(R) trace expression. [contract](trace1.md)
- `trace2(d::URDiagram) -> Any` — Evaluate the unregularized matrix-trace expression assigned to a U(R) diagram. [contract](trace2.md)
- `trace3(d::URDiagram) -> Any` — Evaluate the rank-one block-matrix U(R) trace expression. [contract](trace3.md)
- `trace_value(d::URDiagram) -> Any` — Return the U(R) matrix-trace expression after reducing the supplied diagram in place. [contract](trace_value.md)
- `Z_MST(v::VirtualLink, H::URAlgebra; …) -> Rational{BigInt}` — Evaluate the exact U(R) determinant expression of one closed real-Gauss component. [contract](../o-graph/Z_MST.md)

## move

- `add_edges!(d::URDiagram, pair; …) -> URDiagram` — Merge a selected pair of U(R) diagram edges by adding their weights. [contract](add_edges!.md)
- `compose_dilation!(d::URDiagram, pair; …) -> URDiagram` — Compose a selected pair of adjacent U(R) dilation edges into one edge. [contract](compose_dilation!.md)
- `delete_edge!(d::URDiagram, edge::Integer) -> URDiagram` — Remove one edge and its two endpoint labels from a weighted U(R) diagram. [contract](delete_edge!.md)
- `dilation!(d::URDiagram, dil::Integer, arg::Integer; …) -> URDiagram` — Move a selected signed endpoint across a U(R) dilation pair and update its edge weight. [contract](dilation!.md)
- `put_zero!(d::URDiagram, positive_position::Integer, negative_position::Integer) -> URDiagram` — Insert the paired endpoints of a zero-weight dilation edge into a U(R) diagram. [contract](put_zero!.md)
- `reduct3!(d::URDiagram) -> URDiagram` — Apply the same-sign-group edge-merge relation to a weighted U(R) diagram. [contract](reduct3!.md)
- `reduct4!(d::URDiagram, dilation_edge::Integer) -> URDiagram` — Apply the adjacent-group chord relation relative to supplied U(R) section dilations. [contract](reduct4!.md)
- `reduct4!(d::URDiagram, dilation_edges) -> URDiagram` — Apply the adjacent-group chord relation relative to supplied U(R) section dilations. [contract](reduct4!.md)
- `reduct5!(d::URDiagram) -> URDiagram` — Apply the rank-one zero-weight-dilation relation to a U(R) diagram. [contract](reduct5!.md)
- `reduct6!(d::URDiagram) -> URDiagram` — Apply the first sign-inversion exchange to a weighted U(R) endpoint word. [contract](reduct6!.md)
- `reduct7!(d::URDiagram) -> Tuple{URDiagram,Vector{Bool}}` — Apply a bounded sign-inversion pass and return its interval flags. [contract](reduct7!.md)
- `reduct8!(d::URDiagram) -> URDiagram` — Apply the sectionwise zero-weight-dilation relation to a U(R) diagram. [contract](reduct8!.md)
- `set_data_cm!(d::URDiagram, C, matrix::AbstractMatrix) -> URDiagram` — Replace a U(R) diagram by the weighted endpoint data of a standard coefficient matrix. [contract](set_data_cm!.md)
- `set_data_cvs!(d::URDiagram, C, V, S; …) -> URDiagram` — Replace a U(R) diagram's data with weights perturbed by supplied or formal epsilon values. [contract](set_data_cvs!.md)
- `set_data_cvw!(d::URDiagram, C, V, W) -> URDiagram` — Replace a U(R) diagram's coefficient, vertex word and weights and rebuild its edge table. [contract](set_data_cvw!.md)
- `set_data_v!(d::URDiagram, V) -> URDiagram` — Set a U(R) diagram's vertex word with unspecified numeric weights. [contract](set_data_v!.md)
- `simplify!(d::URDiagram; …) -> URDiagram` — Reduce a weighted U(R) diagram using the multi-rank reduction contract. [contract](simplify!.md)
- `simplify1!(d::URDiagram; …) -> URDiagram` — Apply the rank-one U(R) diagram reduction routine with an iteration bound. [contract](simplify1!.md)
- `simplify2!(d::URDiagram; …) -> URDiagram` — Apply the multi-rank U(R) diagram reduction routine with an iteration bound. [contract](simplify2!.md)
- `simplify2_history!(d::URDiagram; …) -> Tuple{URDiagram,Vector{NamedTuple}}` — Reduce a U(R) diagram and retain the endpoint and interval-flag history of its rounds. [contract](simplify2_history!.md)
- `swap!(d::URDiagram, pair; …) -> URDiagram` — Apply the selected endpoint interchange to a weighted U(R) diagram. [contract](swap!.md)
